summary: The base reproduces the reported excess-placeholder failure. The exact candidate neutralizes stray GLM-V image/video strings in all text-bearing fields named by the issue before structured media rendering, preserves real media placeholders and caller inputs, and passes focused plus independent adversarial validation.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original StopIteration mismatch and empty-suffix RuntimeError with two rendered image placeholders and one media datum.
139 serving-chat tests and 73 subtests passed, including the candidate regression coverage.

Independent image+video matrix across user/assistant/reasoning/tool-call/tool-result/tool-description text reduced counts from 5 image/4 video to exactly one real placeholder each and preserved caller input.
Both serving_chat and base_processor imported from /job/repo/python/sglang rather than an installed package.
One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with 270566162432 bytes VRAM was visible.

gpu_execution.evidence: The failure and candidate change are CPU-side prompt preparation. GPU inventory was recorded, but no model weights were available and GPU execution would not validate placeholder pairing.

remaining_limitations: GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so no full-model HTTP launch or semantic generation was run.
The deterministic tests validate request rendering and the exact processor mismatch contract, not distributed or multi-node serving.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
